experiments.hypothesis: Evidence-rich B2B companies with outdated AI descriptions will engage more often with a concrete failure-pattern observation and Representation Gap diagnostic than with generic GEO-services messaging.
experiments.segment: B2B software and technical-service companies with a documented product, category, brand, or market change in the last 24 months.
experiments.offer: Representation Gap diagnostic leading to the commissioned Representation Baseline when a commercially meaningful problem is verified.
observations: The campaign article was promoted to production in Vercel deployment dpl_Hzx4mtDAVJJHnmvMyANGijUK57y7 and verified at its canonical URL with HTTP 200, analytics, sitemap discovery, llms discovery, and four CTA attribution values.

Deployment dpl_FpKCcpadVyhKuycqnJ7wxvtVa9cZ corrected latest-touch loss across internal navigation and was verified to preserve the original social touch, the latest meaningful article CTA, and the current contact page as separate records.

A 30-query public-search control found a current first-party source for 29 questions; 25 observations aligned, five were mixed or incomplete, and three generic queries required entity disambiguation. This control is explicitly not evidence about an AI answer surface.

Deployment dpl_GbvcMsuZ2NbN638Epd53wGop1ZqF published the narrowed control finding and remediated unintended public serving of internal research files; the affected production paths now return HTTP 404.

A controlled Perplexity Sonar API adapter now preserves all 30 canonical queries, uses one stateless request per query, checkpoints privately, records API-reported cost, and stops at a configured spend ceiling. It is explicitly not labeled as a capture of the consumer Perplexity Pro application; live execution awaits secure credential availability.

experiments.hypothesis: Submitting the evidence-backed campaign revision through site-owner-authenticated IndexNow will produce verifiable participating-search discovery or organic-visit evidence within seven days.
experiments.segment: Search users researching recent B2B company, product, and category changes.
experiments.offer: Representation Gap diagnostic reached from the failure-pattern campaign article.
observations: The first IndexNow request returned HTTP 202 while key validation was pending. After the public root key was verified, the repeated request returned HTTP 200 at 2026-08-09T20:57:24.823Z. Per the protocol, this proves receipt only and does not guarantee crawling or indexing.
